# Polars lazy stream dedup by event_time
q = (
    pl.scan_parquet('s3://lake/cdc/*.parquet')
    .sort('event_time', descending=True)
    .unique(subset=['order_id'], keep='first')
)
df = q.collect(streaming=True)
pyspark:
# PySpark Structured Streaming with Watermark & DropDuplicates
stream = (
    spark.readStream.format('kafka')
    .option('subscribe', 'cdc.orders')
    .load()
    .selectExpr('CAST(value AS STRING) as json_str')
    .select(from_json(col('json_str'), schema).alias('data'))
    .select('data.*')
    .withWatermark('event_time', '10 minutes')
    .dropDuplicates(['order_id', 'event_time'])
    .writeStream.format('delta')
    .option('checkpointLocation', 's3://chk/orders')
    .table('silver.orders')
)

FROM read_parquet('s3://lake/cdc/*.parquet')
GROUP BY order_id;

  TARGET_LAG = '1 minute'

AS

# Polars SCD2 generation via window lag diff
import polars as pl
df = pl.read_parquet('customers_history.parquet')
scd2 = df.sort(['customer_id', 'effective_date']).with_columns([
    pl.col('effective_date').shift(-1).over('customer_id').alias('end_date'),
    (pl.col('effective_date').shift(-1).over('customer_id').is_null()).alias('is_current')
])
sparksql:
-- Databricks Delta SCD2 Merge with deletion vectors
MERGE INTO silver.dim_customer t
USING updates_staged s
ON t.customer_id = s.customer_id AND t.is_current = TRUE
WHEN MATCHED AND t.tier <> s.tier THEN
  UPDATE SET t.is_current = FALSE, t.end_date = s.effective_date;
INSERT INTO silver.dim_customer
SELECT customer_id, tier, effective_date, NULL as end_date, TRUE as is_current
FROM updates_staged;
scala:
// DeltaTable Scala API SCD2 implementation
val target = DeltaTable.forName("silver.dim_customer")
target.as("t").merge(updates.as("s"), "t.id = s.id AND t.is_current = true")
  .whenMatched("t.hash <> s.hash").updateExpr(Map("is_current" -> "false"))
  .execute()

FROM raw_customer_events;

# Polars native join_asof on timestamp
import polars as pl
trades = pl.read_parquet('trades.parquet').sort('trade_time')
quotes = pl.read_parquet('quotes.parquet').sort('quote_time')
matched = trades.join_asof(
    quotes,
    left_on='trade_time',
    right_on='quote_time',
    by='ticker',
    strategy='backward'
)
pyspark:
# PySpark 3.5+ DataFrame join_asof
from pyspark.sql.functions import col
# Window range alternative or join_asof in Spark Connect
matched = trades.join_asof(
    quotes,
    on='timestamp',
    by='ticker',
    direction='backward',
    tolerance=lit('5 seconds')
)
sparksql:
-- Range join with broadcast quote lookup
SELECT t.ticker, t.trade_time, t.trade_price, q.bid, q.ask
FROM trades t
LEFT JOIN quotes q ON t.ticker = q.ticker
  AND q.quote_time = (
    SELECT MAX(q2.quote_time) FROM quotes q2
    WHERE q2.ticker = t.ticker AND q2.quote_time <= t.trade_time
  );
duckdb:
-- DuckDB native ASOF JOIN
SELECT t.ticker, t.trade_time, t.price, q.bid, q.ask
FROM trades t
ASOF JOIN quotes q
  ON t.ticker = q.ticker
 AND t.trade_time >= q.quote_time;
snowflake:
-- Snowflake ASOF JOIN
SELECT t.ticker, t.trade_time, t.price, q.bid, q.ask
FROM trades t
ASOF JOIN quotes q
  MATCH_CONDITION (t.trade_time >= q.quote_time)
  ON t.ticker = q.ticker;
trino:
-- Trino correlated subquery / window lookup
SELECT t.trade_id, q.bid_price
FROM trades t
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT bid_price FROM quotes q
  WHERE q.ticker = t.ticker AND q.ts <= t.ts
  ORDER BY q.ts DESC LIMIT 1
) q;

import polars as pl
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
model = SentenceTransformer('BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5')

df = df.with_columns(pl.Series('embedding', embeddings))

# Delta-rs (Python native without JVM) Optimize & Vacuum
from deltalake import DeltaTable
dt = DeltaTable('s3://lake/gold/transactions')
# Compact small files to 256MB
dt.optimize.compact()
# Vacuum historical snapshots older than 7 days
dt.vacuum(retention_hours=168, enforce_retention_duration=False)
